material.acceptance_criteria: After a .star edit adds a unit kind, the running server without restart serves it in GET /catalog and a mod can spawn it, within 5 seconds of the image rebuild.
material.description: oscraftd reads --data once in Room::new (rust/crates/server/src/room.rs, sim::load_file) and mods.rs reads the image once at startup. The hot path (mod-host reload) covers only the Lua mod file. A unit or behaviour compiled from data/*.star is therefore absent from the running server until restart, and no CI job checks a data edit reaching the served catalog.
material.resolution: A .star edit reaches the running server without a restart: a poll thread rebuilds the data image, validates it, and the tick swaps it in at a boundary, logging ev=data_reloaded. A failed rebuild logs ev=data_reload_failed and keeps the live image. Limits: the swap resets the match (follow-up gap-data-reload-keeps-match-state); the mod host keeps the startup image (follow-up gap-mod-host-follows-data-reload); a map size change is refused and needs a restart.
material.subject: A data-only .star change that adds a unit or behaviour needs a server restart
material.witness: ci-status run 38907774315 for 7b955f4cdbe1aaf274033358f2ae848583c710c8; job data-reload prints ev=data_reloaded and ev=data_reload_failed
material.witness_plan: A CI job builds the catalog image, starts oscraftd, appends a unit to a copy of data/units.star, rebuilds the image with osdt-data, waits for ev=data_reloaded, and asserts GET /catalog lists the new name.
